name: AI Agents Map
author: Uwe Bruckhaus
description: Your AI setup on one map: coding agents with plan, limits and usage, local LLMs (llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, Jan, KoboldCpp) and their models, MCP servers and skills. Connect by drawing a line, with preview and Undo; install, update and sign in from each box's menu. Projects tab: a team of your agents plans and runs work in a project folder, step by step. Ask AI (say what you want, get checked proposals), Reports with a local activity log, What is it doing?, Configure for this PC for local LLMs, a 3D map, update badges, rules for what may be done, dictation.
